text:
Jamie: Merged PR #6802 ~2h ago, noticed a tail latency spike on longseq workloads in canary. p99 jumped from ~420ms to ~1.2s. Canary dashboard: https://internal.redwood/canary/6802 — anyone taking a quick look? cc @Sasha @Li
ops-bot: deploy-bot: Canary deploy complete for pr-6802 at 2041203000, group=longseq-canary :rocket:
Sasha: saw this alert, running bench now. Is the regression only on canary or visible on dedicated tests too?
Jamie: only in canary so far. quick smoke below (batch=1, seq=2048):
```
model: longseq-v1
before (main): p50 110ms  p95 360ms  p99 420ms  mem 6.8GB
after (pr-6802): p50 115ms  p95 480ms  p99 1200ms  mem 7.1GB
```
Li: that looks like the KV refill/backoff tweak we landed in the PR. could increase microbatch latency under sparse cache hits. @Sasha any ideas on which function is the main culprit?
Sasha: yes, pr touched refill/backoff and the eviction jitter. I'll bisect the branch and run the microbatch latency bench (microbatch-bench --seq 2048). Will paste results. :mag:
Ryan: if bisect confirms, let's hold any further merges to main and prepare a revert. Who can approve a hot revert if needed? @Jamie?
Jamie: I'll hold merges. I can approve a revert and trigger a canary rollback if Sasha's bisect shows regression is from that commit. Pinging infra for priority rollback playbook. :thumbsup:
Sasha: quick bisect output (short):
```
commit abc123 -> p99 430ms
commit def456 -> p99 1150ms  (this is where refill/backoff change landed)
profiling: increased time in kv_cache::refill_loop (~45% more sys time), higher mutex contention
```
Li: ok that pins it. mitigation options: 1) revert the refill/backoff tweak, 2) tune backoff to previous values, or 3) add an async refill worker to decouple refill from request path. 1 is fastest for prod.
Ryan: +1 revert for now. Jamie, can you open the revert PR and tag oncall for expedited deploy?
Jamie: opened revert PR #6802-revert and requested expedited deploy from infra: https://internal.redwood/pr/6802-revert. I'll monitor canary and post updates. :eyes:
ops-bot: infra-bot: revert PR linked, rollback scheduled for canary at 2041203700 if CI passes.
Sasha: after revert runs I'll re-run full perf suite and post the heatmap. thanks everyone for quick triage.
Ryan: thanks — good catch and nice quick bisect.
